propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently wastes billing by running all remaining LLM passes and only failing at sign time when own_material changes are detected

Checkpoint keys are fingerprint-based so no completed work survives a mid-run edit; the cancel must probe only own material to avoid reintroducing false cancels on unrelated ticket writes (d70a regression)
The cancel probe must execute at exactly two between-pass seams (after finders and after decide) and raise an out-of-band exception before recovery paths attempt to salvage a verdict
A mid-run own-material change produces an INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding, skips all signing and sidecar emission, and returns exit 2 to the CLI
The probe performs only a single-ticket light read under local_read_context and never fetches store-wide state, relation snapshots, or takes the sync lock
